dashboard_revenue: Total revenue collected minus refunds over the selected period.
dashboard_visitors: Unique people who visited your store.
settings_taxes: Configure how sales tax is calculated at checkout.
inventory_low_stock: Items with fewer than 5 units left in stock.
ai_agent_greeting: The first message your AI assistant will send to customers.
marketing_campaign_budget: The maximum amount you want to spend on this campaign.
payment_gateway_stripe: Connect Stripe to accept credit card payments.
shipping_flat_rate: Charge the same shipping fee for all orders.
storefront_theme: Choose how your online store looks to customers.
customer_tags: Labels to help you organize and filter your customer list.
